task.title: Document the Android dev-attach breakthroughs in the android-smoke skill
task.description: Filed from P6-031 (2026-08-10). Two host/skill documentation updates from the emulator verification session: (1) adb reverse tcp:3000 tcp:3000 + navigating the webview to the plain http://127.0.0.1:3000 origin allows REAL authed sign-in on the device build, bypassing the tauri:// proxy that strips cookies/POST bodies — this overturns the skill's documented 'authed surfaces are bench-only on Android dev-attach' limitation (dated 2026-07-19) and should become the skill's documented path; note the harness-only 'Cannot redefine property: postMessage' console noise it causes (Tauri IPC re-injecting on foreign-origin navigation — not a product defect, two-line repro exists). (2) The host's Android Studio JBR (25.x) is too new for the pinned Gradle/Kotlin DSL (JavaVersion.parse fails); brew openjdk@21 passed as JAVA_HOME for the one command fixes it — document in the skill and .devcontainer/README.md. Also: Tauri's build.rs hard-codes target/site/pkg regardless of CARGO_TARGET_DIR (mkdir -p needed). A reusable probe script landed as end2end/android-teardown-undo-check.mjs (npm run probe:android-teardown-undo). Specs: specs/app-ui.md (P6-031 Findings).
